wcm.note: Will Can Must sheets, already shared with HR by the employee

manager_notes.note: manager notes, shown beside the employee's own words, never instead of them

sessions.note: AI assistant session summaries, only where opted_in is true

rules: Every claim must cite at least one source id from an allowed source, or it is dropped.
The subject sees the same page as the evaluator.
No score is presented as a verdict; ranking is a re-ordering of evidence for a stated criterion.
The page exists for one named decision and is deleted when it is made.

crud_log.note: every add, edit or remove of a person record: who asked, what they said, what changed. Drafts are never logged; only confirmed writes.
